# SalesOn

> SalesOn provides sales and distribution software for field teams, distributors and manufacturers.

Use linked pages for current capabilities, pricing, support and terms. Free tools are standalone business utilities; customer stories describe individual customer workflows.

## Getting started and support

- [SalesOn Help & Onboarding | Setup and Video Guides](https://saleson.co.in/help): Get started with SalesOn. Find setup and business review videos, attendance guidance, password recovery and help with products and routes.
- [SalesOn Pricing | Pro & Enterprise Plans for 2+ Users](https://saleson.co.in/pricing): Compare regional SalesOn Pro and Enterprise plans in INR or USD. Paid subscriptions start with 2 users. Calculate monthly or annual costs and check included workflows.
- [Book a SalesOn Demo | 30-Min Live Walkthrough](https://saleson.co.in/request-demo): Book a 30-minute SalesOn demo for distributors and field sales teams. Get a role-based walkthrough, fit assessment and module recommendation.

## Product and company

- [SalesOn | Sales and Distribution Software for Your Team](https://saleson.co.in/): Connect field sales, orders, stock, invoicing and collections with SalesOn. Explore workflows for distributors and manufacturers, compare plans and book a demo.
- [About SalesOn | Distribution Software for Indian MSMEs](https://saleson.co.in/about): Meet SalesOn founders Shruti Sahay and Suraj Jaiswal. Learn how their engineering and Quintol experience shaped the sales and distribution platform.
- [Field Attendance App for Sales Teams | Photo & GPS Check-In | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/attendance): Track field staff attendance with photo and GPS check-ins, odometer logs, work hours and attendance reports for HR review. Free 7-day trial.
- [Sales Leakage & ROI Estimate Calculator | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/calculators/sales-leakage-calculator): Estimate possible sales leakage and ROI using your sales figures and adjustable assumptions. Results are estimates, not audited losses or guaranteed savings.
- [Delivery Management Software for Distributors | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/delivery-management): Assign confirmed-order shipments, manage driver trips, record proof of delivery and review reattempts with SalesOn delivery management software.
- [Distributor Management System & Software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/distribution-management-system): Connect secondary sales, multi-godown stock and customer balances with SalesOn distributor management software. Explore DMS for FMCG and distribution teams.
- [Field Sales Expense Management Software & TA/DA | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/expense-management): Manage field sales expense claims, receipt photographs, TA/DA policy checks and manager approvals. Give finance approved records for reimbursement review.
- [Field Sales Management Software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/field-sales): Manage customer visits, routes, orders and daily activity with SalesOn field sales software and SFA app for FMCG, distributors and manufacturers. Book a demo.
- [Field Sales Quiz | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/guide/quiz-pro): Test your field sales knowledge with the SalesOn quiz. Practise everyday sales decisions in English and Indian languages, with feedback after each answer.
- [Inventory management software for distributors | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/inventory-management): Review product stock by godown, configured batch and expiry records, and the stock context behind ordering, billing and van operations.
- [GST Invoicing Software for Distributors & Manufacturers | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/invoicing): Create sales invoices, review GST and totals, share PDFs on WhatsApp, print supported formats and apply credit notes. Built for distributor and manufacturer billing teams.
- [SalesOn Mobile App | Downloads, Devices & Permissions](https://saleson.co.in/mobile-app): Download SalesOn for Android or iPhone. Review company setup, team sign-in, device compatibility, permissions and internet requirements.
- [Order Taking App for Salesman | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/order-taking-app): Capture distributor orders with SKU search, customer-wise prices and applicable schemes. Review quantities and credit information, then share confirmation.
- [Interested in partnering with SalesOn? | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/partner): Our partner programme is not yet live. Email your interest so the team can discuss the opportunity and confirm terms when available.
- [Payment Collection Software India | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/payment-collection): Track outstanding invoices, record UPI, cash and cheque collections, manage credit limits, and prepare clean receipt reports for accounts.
- [Production Management Software for Manufacturers | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/production): Manage multi-level BOMs, work orders, raw material use, batch costs and finished goods with SalesOn production management software. Book a manufacturing demo.
- [Salesman Tracking App & Software India | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/salesman-tracking): View your sales team’s latest locations, date-wise routes, distance, field time and activity logs. For distributor and manufacturer sales managers.
- [Tally Integration Software for Distributors & Manufacturers | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tally-integration): Connect SalesOn with Tally for sales vouchers, receipts and master data. Review sync directions, ledger mapping and accounting exceptions with your team.
- [Sales Target & Incentive Tracking Software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/target-meter): Track sales targets, territory achievement, product-category goals and incentive progress with SalesOn Target Meter. For distributors, manufacturers and their sales teams.
- [Van Sales Software for India, UAE & Oman | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/van-sales): Manage ready-stock van sales with vehicle-wise stock, outlet billing, payments, returns and day-end review. For distributors and manufacturers in India and the Middle East.

## Industries and business use cases

- [Agricultural distribution sales software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/agriculture): For agricultural distributors organising dealer visits, product orders and collections while checking availability before fulfilment.
- [Automotive parts distribution software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/automotive): For automotive parts distributors connecting dealer visits, product selection, customer prices and delivery follow-up.
- [Cosmetics distribution sales software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/cosmetic): For cosmetics distributors managing outlet orders across product ranges, customer-specific prices and follow-up collections.
- [Electronics distribution sales software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/electronics): For electronics distributors reviewing dealer orders, SKU availability, customer prices and outstanding balances.
- [FMCG sales and distribution software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/fmcg): For FMCG distributors reviewing repeat outlet orders, customer prices, schemes and collections across a busy sales day.
- [Hardware distribution sales software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/hardware): For hardware distributors capturing dealer orders, checking customer prices and following supply from the godown.
- [Manufacturer-to-distributor order workflow | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/manufacturing): Follow a manufacturer-to-distributor order through finished-goods availability, billing and dispatch. See where the workflow hands over to Production.
- [Pharmaceutical distribution sales software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/pharmacy): Review chemist and dealer orders, customer dues, and configured batch or expiry records for pharmaceutical distribution. Confirm specialist requirements.
- [Publishing distribution sales software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/publishing): For publishers and publication distributors evaluating dealer orders, catalogue items, stock availability and customer dues.
- [Sports and fitness equipment distribution software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/sport-and-fitness): For distributors selling sports equipment or fitness products to dealers and business customers, with an office team reviewing stock and billing.
- [Telecom product distribution sales software | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/telecommunication): For distributors supplying telecom products through dealers and outlets, with field reps collecting demand and the office managing the sale.
- [Delivery operations software for transport teams | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/industries/transport): For businesses evaluating the delivery part of their sales operation: assigning responsibility, following shipments and reviewing delivery exceptions.
- [Sales and distribution software for distributors | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/user/software-for-distributors): Connect outlet orders, stock review, billing and collections. Choose the workflows your reps and office need to run together.
- [Sales and distribution software for manufacturers | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/user/software-for-manufacturers): Evaluate SalesOn for distributor orders, finished-goods stock, billing and collections. Compare the modules your manufacturing business needs.
- [Orders and billing software for retailers | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/user/software-for-retailers): Evaluate customer orders, invoice sharing and printing, stock review and payment records for your retail business. Confirm counter/POS requirements in a demo.

## Free business tools

- [Free GST, Billing, Inventory & Business Tools | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools): Use free browser tools for GST calculations, invoices, quotations, challans, receipts, payment tracking, stock reorder planning and van loading sheets.
- [Free Delivery Challan Generator under GST | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/delivery-challan-generator): Create delivery challans for stock transfer, job work, dispatch, van loading and GST goods movement with triplicate copies and PDF download.
- [Free E-Way Bill Requirement Checker | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/e-way-bill-checker): Check whether an e-way bill may be required for GST goods movement based on value, state, document type and dispatch reason. Free tool by SalesOn.
- [Free GST Calculator Online for Indian Businesses | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/gst-calculator): Calculate GST inclusive and exclusive amounts, CGST, SGST, IGST, taxable value, invoice totals and reverse GST. Free tool by SalesOn.
- [Free GST Invoice Generator for Indian Businesses | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/gst-invoice-generator): Create GST invoices with GSTIN, HSN/SAC, CGST, SGST, IGST, logo, item table and PDF download. Free tool for Indian MSMEs by SalesOn.
- [HSN Goods Heading Lookup | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/hsn-sac-gst-rate-finder): Search 28 goods-heading candidates. Verify the exact classification and GST rate before using an invoice or quotation. No service/SAC or automatic rate lookup.
- [Free Outstanding Payment Tracker for Businesses | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/outstanding-payment-tracker): Track pending payments, overdue invoices, ageing buckets, party-wise outstanding and WhatsApp reminders. Free collection tracker by SalesOn.
- [Free Payment Receipt Generator for India | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/payment-receipt-generator): Create payment receipts for cash, UPI, bank transfer, cheque, advance, partial payments and outstanding balance. Free PDF tool by SalesOn.
- [Free Purchase Order Generator for India | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/purchase-order-generator): Create purchase orders with vendor details, item list, GST, delivery terms, payment terms, approval section and PDF download. Free tool by SalesOn.
- [Free Quotation Generator for Indian Businesses | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/quotation-generator): Create professional quotations and estimates with GST, logo, item pricing, validity date, payment terms and PDF download. Free tool by SalesOn.
- [Free Stock Reorder Level Calculator | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/stock-reorder-level-calculator): Calculate reorder level, reorder quantity, safety stock, days of stock remaining and stock-out risk for SKUs. Free inventory tool by SalesOn.
- [Free Van Loading Sheet Generator for Distributors | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/van-loading-sheet-generator): Create van loading sheets, route stock records, EOD reconciliation, returns summary and collection summary. Free van sales tool by SalesOn.
- [Free WhatsApp Payment Reminder Generator | SalesOn](https://saleson.co.in/tools/whatsapp-payment-reminder-generator): Generate polite WhatsApp payment reminders for pending invoices, overdue payments, partial payments and credit customers. Free tool by SalesOn.
